name: Fine-tuning the PSM (GLiNER2.5 base) and the LFM (T5-base NL-to-FOL) on verified teacher formalizations of book problems
registered_by: psm-lfm-agent (draft; frozen when the owner confirms Q-TRAIN-1 in questions.md)
owner_request: Owner decision 2026-10-03: new formalization architecture (tiny at the edges; PSM extracts structure; LFM writes FOL; deterministic translation to SOP). Owner sentence: "facem fine tuning la modelele alea două mici, dacă e cazul" (fine-tune the two small models, if needed). Run-level confirmation asked in questions.md Q-TRAIN-1.
frozen_before_results: Written after the zero-shot probe (state/structure-formalizer/probe-1, experiments/proposal/structure-and-formalizer-models.md §4) and before any teacher data generation, any optimizer step and any prediction of a fine-tuned checkpoint.
question: Do the two fine-tuned small models (PSM + LFM) with the deterministic FOL/PSM-to-SOP converters formalize held-out book problems better than the current pipeline (correct up, wrong not up)?
needed: yes, from the zero-shot probe on 30 problems: PSM goal recall 7/30, quantity recall 86/139; LFM question units as queries 4/32, numbers glued into predicate names 50/139, 1/30 correct (closed-world no).
hypotheses: H1: PSM goal recall >= 80% and quantity recall >= 90% on held-out sections after T-PSM-1.
H2: PSM+LFM pipeline correct >= current + 10 points per 100 with wrong <= current on held-out sections.

data.pool: datasets_sources/books/eval/items.jsonl scorable (tools/eval/structure-formalizer/gold.mjs), never seen (seen.jsonl), local only (DS011)
data.test: 20% of the sections of each book by sha256(seed train-psm-lfm-v1/section), frozen before D1; never in training; ~690 items
data.generation: D1: teachers small (Qwen3.8 27b) and medium (deepseek-v4-flash) each write PSM spans+relations and per-sentence FOL in the agreed target (structure-and-formalizer-models.md §5); one repair round each; pilot 50 problems, at most 2 prompt-fix rounds, then the pool (~2,750)
data.keep: verbatim spans; FOL compiles with no rejected unit bearing a number or the question; executes to the book answer (lib/formalize/equivalence.mjs); the executed circuit gives the book answer on the problem own numbers and passes the static data-dependency check (no perturbation, deviation 2026-10-03); PSM goal and quantity spans of both teachers overlap; every number of the verified program inside a quantity span
data.sizes: go gate >= 600 verified problems (expected ~1,100 => ~7,500 LFM sentence pairs, ~1,100 PSM documents); no section above 10%
data.budget: LLMJobs: calls 9000, usd 5; small ~275 plan credits

arms.T-PSM-1: full fine-tune of fastino/gliner2.5-base-v1 (gliner2 trainer; fallback fastino/gliner2-base-v1 if 2.5 cannot be trained with open code): AdamW, lr encoder 1e-5, heads 5e-5, batch 8, <= 10 epochs, early stop on dev span F1 (goal, quantity, condition, rule) patience 2, seed 1; 90/10 train/dev by section; ONNX export, served as a new folder of the structure tier
arms.T-LFM-1: full fine-tune continuing from fvossel/t5-base-nl-to-fol: AdamW lr 3e-4, batch 16, max input 512 / output 256 tokens, <= 10 epochs, early stop on dev execution accuracy (converters + engines) patience 2, seed 1; input = sentence + PSM inventory; ONNX export with export-t5-onnx.sh, served as a new folder of the formalizer tier
arms.baseline: current product formalizer (config/runtime.json queryParser, LocalLLMStepByStep on tiny) and the expression path on tiny, on the same items

changed_factor: the PSM and LFM checkpoints (fine-tuned vs zero-shot); converters fixed at the commit of the run
compute: GB10 GPU, Python + CUDA torch in the frozen branch rootless Podman CUDA image; models/.training.lock during training; estimate PSM 5-20 min, LFM 20-60 min, < 2 h total; one GPU job at a time
early_stopping: D1: stop if the pilot yield < 15% after 2 prompt fixes, or < 600 verified problems on the pool (no training). Training: early stop per arm as above; at most one rerun per arm. E1: stages 50 / 100 / rest with paired bootstrap; success when decisive in the preregistered direction; futility at stage 50 if executed < 30% or correct < current - 5; broken if > 20% unparsable or empty outputs in the first 50.
evaluation: held-out sections; correct / wrong / unknown per 100 (a wrong circuit apart from an honest unknown); PSM span F1 on verified test labels; LFM unit conversion and execution rates; latency; AGENTS.md levels (a) known forms new words, (b) held-out sections, (c) a small free-question set, reported separately; paired bootstrap vs baseline
non_goals: publishing checkpoints or training data (books not cleared, DS011; fvossel training data non-commercial)

deviations.what: D1 stopped after the pilot (owner decision): training is deferred, so teacher data is not needed. Kept: the pilot runs state/llm-jobs/train-data-d1/20261003T073009-c6fb63 (small, 50 settled) and 20261003T073807-0c7adc (medium, 40 of 50 settled when stopped); no further generation.

Perturbation check dropped from scoring and acceptance (owner decision): invented variants can be invalid problems and the check caught only a handful of lucky circuits. Replacement: (1) a pipeline is right when its executed SOP gives the book answer on the problem own numbers; (2) a static check refuses a circuit whose answer does not depend on the problem numbers through its dataflow (lib/formalize/fol/to-sop.mjs, as lib/formalize/expression-program.mjs already did for copies and constants); (3) verification without gold: two formalizations agree on the original numbers, three for yes/no answers (lib/formalize/dual-check.mjs, perturbation optional, off by default). The D1 keep rule and E1 are amended accordingly.

deviations.note: Withdrawn by the owner: 'nu facem fine tuning la ele, ai demonstrat că nu are sens'. The A/B showed role-prompted tiny (now the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE) beating GLiNER2.5 and T5 NL->FOL zero-shot; no training run was started.
